name: Drop Shadow
description: A soft dark shadow behind the window, cast slightly downward the way a real light would. It follows the frame's corners, rounded or squared, and draws only where the window is not fully opaque, so a window with a see-through body picks up a little of it near the edge. It dims when the window loses focus.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Fireflies
description: A handful of soft glowing sparks drifting around the window in the clear margin outside its frame, each blinking on its own rhythm. The swarm dims when the surface loses focus. Count, spark size, drift range, drift speed and the two spark colours are this pack's own parameters.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Glow
description: A soft coloured halo that hugs the surface's edge, brightest against the window and fading out over the glow size. It follows the frame's corners, rounded or squared, and draws only where the surface is not fully opaque, so a window with a see-through body picks up a little of it near the edge. It dims when the surface loses focus.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Opacity and Tint
description: Fades the window's surface and can wash it with a colour of your choice. Opacity dims the whole surface, while the tint blends it toward the tint colour by the amount you set. Leave the tint strength at zero for a plain fade.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Phosphor Motes
description: The window sheds embers of luminous dust from its own frame. Each mote is born on an edge and drifts straight out from it through the clear margin, so the dust radiates evenly in every direction, trailing its own path history back toward the frame. Near motes are larger, brighter and faster than far ones, a few flare into rare bright embers, and a fine halo of twinkling micro dust hugs the frame. Colour burns through the brand gradient over each mote's life, born cyan at the frame and fading out rose at the end of its drift. The dust dims when the surface loses focus.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Blur
description: A plain blur behind the window. The scene behind the surface is blurred and lightly tinted, and shows through wherever the window itself is translucent. Brightness, contrast, saturation, vibrancy and a fine grain shape the blurred scene. The bottom corners can be left square. The Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the blur.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Duotone
description: The scene behind the window is blurred and then remapped onto a two-colour gradient by brightness, for the concert-poster look. The darkest parts of the scene take the shadow colour and the brightest take the highlight colour. It shows through wherever the window itself is translucent, and the Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the gradient.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Frosted Glass
description: A frosted panel over a real blur. The scene behind the surface is blurred and tinted by a slowly turning two-colour gradient. A crystalline grain and a soft vignette sit on top. Where nothing sits behind the surface it falls back to the original translucent gradient slab. The Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the pane.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Glass
description: A pane of glass over the scene behind the window. The backdrop is blurred and bends toward the edges like a bevelled lens, with slight colour fringing and a soft rim light. It shows through wherever the window itself is translucent, and the Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the glass.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Mosaic
description: The scene behind the window is pixelated into coarse cells rather than blurred, for the privacy-glass look. Its colours still show through, and at anything but the smallest cell sizes nothing behind it is readable. It shows through wherever the window itself is translucent, and the Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the mosaic.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Phosphor Glass
description: Dark navy glass over a real blur that behaves like a phosphor screen. Bright content behind the surface excites a glowing response in the brand gradient, and the glow breathes like phosphor persistence. A slow diagonal sweep recharges the pane as it passes. Where nothing sits behind the surface it falls back to a translucent navy slab with the same shimmer. The Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the glass.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Rain on Glass
description: The scene behind the window fogged by a blur, with rain droplets running down the pane. Each droplet refracts the scene and leaves a trail of beads that fade as it falls. Droplet size, Rain amount, Fall speed and Refraction set how big the drops are, how many fall, how fast they run and how hard each one bends the scene behind it. It shows through wherever the window itself is translucent, and the Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the rain.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Rippled Glass
description: A pane of rippled glass over the scene behind the window. The blurred backdrop warps across the whole pane under a drifting watery distortion, with slight colour fringing and soft highlights along the ripples. It shows through wherever the window itself is translucent, and the Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the ripples.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Audio Border
description: A rounded border that pulses with the music. The bass energy pushes the border toward a pulse colour and brightens it on each beat. It reacts on window borders, OSDs and popups whenever the audio visualizer is turned on, and stays a plain static frame when it is off.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Border
description: Rounded corners and a window border. Clips the surface to a rounded rectangle and lays a configurable border band over the desktop, so a translucent border blends with what is behind the surface rather than its own content.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Circuit Border
description: Rounded corners and a window border textured as a hex circuit, with bright data pulses travelling around the band over a dim base grid. The cells flicker faintly and the whole band dims when the surface loses focus.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Double Border
description: Rounded corners with two concentric border lines separated by a clear gap, each with its own width and colour. The lines dim when the surface loses focus.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Gradient Border
description: Rounded corners and a window border coloured by a still two-colour gradient across the frame. The gradient direction is set in degrees, and the band dims when the surface loses focus.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Marching Ants
description: Rounded corners and a dashed window border whose dashes march around the frame, the classic selection marquee. The motion dims when the surface loses focus.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Phosphor Border
description: Rounded corners and a window border carrying the Phosphor brand gradient from cyan to rose, flowing slowly around the frame with a soft gleam orbiting the band. The whole band dims when the surface loses focus.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Pulse Border
description: Rounded corners and a window border that breathes between two colours on a smooth cycle, with an optional brightness dip at the low end. The pulse dims when the surface loses focus.
author: PlasmaZones

name: RGB Cycle
description: Rounded corners and a window border painted as a full colour wheel wrapped around the frame, slowly rotating. The classic gaming-rig ring. Set the speed to zero for a still rainbow.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Sweep Border
description: Rounded corners and a window border with a moving colour sweep. Two colours circulate around the border band, and the sweep dims when the surface loses focus.
author: PlasmaZones

name: Focus Fade
description: Washes out the window itself while it is unfocused, so the focused window stands out at a glance. Unfocused windows lose saturation, darken slightly and can take an optional tint. The focused window passes through untouched. Desaturation, dimming, tint strength and the tint colour are this pack's own parameters.
author: PlasmaZones
